violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: cooked vegetables (cabbage, carrots and onions) were not temping properly at 90F on hot service line.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC PROPER HOT HOLDING TEMPS. PIC REHEATED THE VEGETABLES TO 135F AND PUT THEM BACK ON THE HOT SERVICE LINE. PIC ALSO TURNED UP THE TEMP OF THE HOT SERVICE LINE.

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: There was no certified food manager present in the facility during the inspection. The PIC did not have certified food manager credentials.
violations.corrective_action: The certified food manager will need to provide proof of presence and active credentials to the EHS for a follow up within 10 days.

out_items.name: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting

violations.title: Duty of PIC, Employee Health Policy in Place
violations.observation: The PIC was unable to provide the documents or details of an Employee Health policy to the EHS.
violations.corrective_action: EHS provided the Employee Health policy again, by email, for compliance and reviewed the information with the manager for understanding.

out_items.name: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events

violations.title: Clean-up of vomiting and diarrheal events
violations.observation: The food establishment does not have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events.
violations.corrective_action: The EHS provided the vomit and diarrhea clean up procedures again, to the PIC, by email for compliance.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at the handwashing sink, located in the kitchen area.
violations.corrective_action: The PIC replaced the hand soap at the hand sink during the inspection for compliance. SUKI HANA JAPAN (Inspection Date: 05/15/2025) Page 2 of 4

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at the handwashing sink, located by the ice machine.
violations.corrective_action: The PIC placed paper towels at the hand washing sink during the inspection for compliance.

out_items.name: Required records available: shellstock tags, parasite destruction

violations.title: Records, Parasite Destruction by Freezing
violations.observation: No records of freezing for parasite destruction are maintained for the following raw, raw marinated, partially cooked or marinated-partially cooked fish that are served or sold in ready-to-eat form: raw seafood on the sushi menu, such as salmon.
violations.corrective_action: The PIC will need to obtain a letter of parasite destruction for the raw seafood that is sold on the sushi menu and provide proof to the EHS for a follow up within 10 days.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: bags of chopped cabbage in WIC.
violations.corrective_action: The PIC placed labels with the dates on the bags of cabbage for proper discard.

out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food
violations.observation: A review of the menu with the foodservice operator indicates that there is no consumer advisory for the following food item(s) that may be served raw and/or undercooked: all raw seafood products on the sushi menu
violations.corrective_action: The PIC will need to correct the menu to include the disclosure and reminder statements. Make sure to put asterisks on the raw animal proteins served, along with the added statement that “these items may be served raw or undercooked “ in front of front of the reminder statements. Please provide proof of corrected menu to the EHS for a follow up within 10 days.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: large bins of salt, sugar, brown sugar and cornstarch under the prep table; multiple bottles of oil, water and sauces at cookline and prep top tables, without names
violations.corrective_action: The PIC placed the common names on the bins and bottles during the inspection for compliance.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: scoop utensils in hot water on the side of the grill; water registered at 124F.
violations.corrective_action: The pan of hot water was reheated during the inspection and maintained at 135F
